caption: The drawing depicts a doll standing upright, facing forward, against a plain, off-white background. The doll has a round face with light skin, blue eyes, short brownish hair, and defined eyebrows and lips. It wears a bonnet that is white with blue trim, covering the head and tied under the chin. The dress is long, reaching the floor, and has a soft pinkish hue with a subtle floral pattern. The dress features a high waistline with a thin, red ribbon-like belt just below the bodice. The neckline and sleeve cuffs are decorated with ruffled white lace. The lower part of the dress is adorned with several horizontal red stripes near the hem. The doll's hands are visible, with brown gloves or painted hands. The signature "EDWARD LOPER DELT." is visible at the bottom right corner.
title: Wax Doll
